description: There's a 5% chance for you fly into a berserk rage whenever you kill an enemy with a melee attack. While in berserk rage, you will deal 10% increased melee damage and consume 50% less stamina per attack, but will be unable to gain any other martial art stacks.  Berserk rage lasts for 6 turns and can be extended by killing enemies while it is active.
Your chance to enter berserk rage on a melee kill is increased to 15%.
You have infinite stamina while berserk.
Theres a 75% chance for melee attacks to not consume insight stacks while berserk rage is active.

Suffused with hate at the nanoangstrom scale.
 You generate 25 bionic power for every turn berserk rage is active.

"Arrrgghh!!"
- Test Subject 21 

If berserk rage is active and your bionic are above 50% full, your melee attacks will be will deal additional electric damage with a chance of the damage arcing to other nearby targets.
